bedrock.decision: Retain maintained Java port UUIDs, persistence and repairs; do not replace with first author Bedrock release.

adopted_domains: Maotai and Dassai effect rows in direct drinks and signature inputs
green/pink two-half pendant lamps; blue/green/pink dye recipes
current cabinet models and textures, preserving IDs and storage
Explosion base power 5; submerged-eye CaptainGift exclusion; 0.5-base air multi-jump velocity
Luck+ native entity-death/drop adapter and appended optional HUD icon

TreasureSense per-viewer outlines and Java team ownership/color renderer; no Bedrock outline currently shipped
Full Forge/NeoForge branch parity and human rendering/audio/gameplay acceptance

luck_source.rule: Reroll the original table, adding only item types not already present in the initial drops or previous extra rolls. Preserve complete native stack metadata.
holder_priority: this entity or fishing-hook player owner
luck_source.correction: The 2026-10-27 review incorrectly said retain initially present types. Verified current LuckLootModifier bytecode uses Set.add true, which adds previously absent types.

bedrock_adaptations.luck: Native entityDie/entityItemDrop identifies the exact original drop cohort. LootTableManager rerolls that same dead actor with the captured tool. Bedrock does not expose the complete Java LootContext, original chest loot-table ID or a global loot modifier callback in the selected API; no nearby-drop cloning or independent fake baseline is used.
bedrock_adaptations.native_array: BDS1.26.60 native EntityItemDrop items is array-shaped without Symbol.iterator; capture once and read by index.
bedrock_adaptations.lamp: Shared Tavern optional vertical-double lifecycle; source item sprites and per-face UVs, including green model using the pink atlas, retained.
bedrock_adaptations.cabinet: Current Java resource conversion replaces retired cabinet-only topology projections; IDs/states/storage and item display transforms remain.
bedrock_adaptations.blue_recipe: The blue product already belongs to Tavern. Its dye recipe and guide preparation are delivered by Tavern, avoiding a foreign-owned guide item or duplicate recipe. Green/pink recipes and pages remain optional World Liquor content.
